title: Partition Labels
statement: Cut the string into as many pieces as possible so that no letter appears in more than one piece. Return the piece lengths in order.
hints: A piece cannot end before the LAST occurrence of every letter it contains.
So first record the last index of each letter in one pass.
Then sweep, extending the current piece end to the furthest last-occurrence seen so far. When the scan index reaches that end, the piece closes.
